summary: Mt. Hood cab built around 1930 by the USFS, half a mile SSW of Cloud Cap Inn; abandoned and gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says the cab is now gone; firelookout.com says it was abandoned, with no date given

events.note: Morning Oregonian item of October 13, 1927, quoted by Forest Lookouts, proposes a station and mentions a cabin built on the summit several years earlier; not confirmed as this cab
Around 1930 per the register; firelookout.com also gives 1930
Registered August 17, 2010 as US 583, OR 24; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: cab built around 1930 by the USFS on a ridge half a mile SSW of Cloud Cap Inn; now gone
evidence.quote: Around 1930 the USFS constructed this cab on a descending ridge of Mt. Hood, 1/2 mile SSW of Cloud Cap Inn. The lookout is now gone.

evidence.supports: 1930 cab, half mile SSW of Cloud Cap Inn; abandoned; gone

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1927 Oregonian item quoted by Forest Lookouts describes a cabin on the summit several years before 1927, which does not match the around-1930 date both lookout registers give; not resolved. The cab sits on a ridge, while the 1927 item speaks of the summit. No staffing, fire or current-site description found. Access unknown, so no access key. A field check or a Mount Hood National Forest inquiry would settle what remains. Brief record (2010 registration, gone status) checks out.
